annotations.title: Student housing data for one campus

description: One US four-year campus (3,000+ full-time students) from federal IPEDS data: fall 2024 enrollment (total, full-time, undergraduate, graduate, online share, change from 2023), college-controlled housing beds for 2024-25, beds per 100 full-time students, the bed gap, typical housing and food charges, aid-office housing budgets, and whether it meets Fannie Mae's 10,000-student campus-size test. Find it by name (with optional state) or IPEDS UNITID.

name.description: Campus name or distinctive words from it, e.g. "University of Florida" or "texas austin".

state.description: Two-letter state code to narrow a name match, e.g. TX.

unitid.description: Six-digit IPEDS UNITID, e.g. 228778. Overrides name.

name: get_campus
title: Student housing data for one campus
